title: A company is onboarded
goal: A company starts on the platform: the platform owner creates its tenant and gives it its first system owner, who signs in and appoints a coordinator, and the platform owner then puts the tenant in use.

actors.description: Operates the platform, onboards new tenants and moves them between states.
Owns the new tenant's setup and appoints its people.

preconditions: The end-to-end database was prepared in this run with the platform owner as its one persona; the company does not exist yet.

steps.intent: Start a new tenant for the company from the platform console
steps.outcome: The new tenant's form holds the company's name and description.

steps.intent: Give the tenant its first system owner and create it
steps.outcome: The tenant exists in setup with its first system owner, whose initial password is shown once.

steps.intent: Sign in with the initial password while the tenant is in setup
steps.outcome: The system owner is signed in to their own tenant, which admits only its system owners while in setup.

steps.intent: Add a coordinator and give them the Coordinator role for the whole company
steps.outcome: The coordinator is a user of the tenant holding the Coordinator role on the company.

steps.intent: See the tenant's people on its console and put the tenant in use
steps.outcome: The console lists the system owner and the coordinator with their roles, and the tenant is active.

completion: The company's tenant is active, with its system owner and a coordinator holding the Coordinator role on the company, and the platform owner never acted inside it.
